title: FluxReconcileConfig
description: Config of the flux-reconcile custom step. Not vendored: written for this repository, and kept in step with the checks at the top of src/flux-reconcile, which are what the step actually enforces.

kubeconfig.description: Contents of a kubeconfig for the cluster Flux runs in, typically ${{ secret('<name>').kubeconfig }}. Static credentials only: the image has no exec credential plugins.

context.description: Context to use from the kubeconfig. Defaults to its current-context.

timeout.description: How long to wait for all targets together, as a duration (90s, 10m, 1h30m). Defaults to 10m. Keep it below the step's own timeout in the promotion.

requireHealthCheck.description: Fail any target whose Ready condition would not mean its workloads are healthy: a Kustomization without spec.wait or spec.healthChecks, a HelmRelease with waiting disabled.

targets.description: Flux objects to reconcile, in order.

desiredRevision.description: For a Kustomization, a full commit SHA or an OCI digest (with or without its sha1:/sha256: prefix). For a HelmRelease, a chart version or the chart's OCI digest. Without it, the target must have applied what its source holds once refreshed.

withSource.description: Refresh the target's source chain before the target itself. Defaults to true.
